faq.question: Is face wash allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Face Wash is restricted in carry-on luggage. Face wash cleansers (liquid, foam, or gel) must comply with the 3-1-1 liquids rule (3.4 oz or less in carry-on).

faq.answer: Yes, Face Wash is allowed in checked bags. Face wash is allowed in checked baggage in any size.
